reason: A self-hosted Claude-compatible runtime for deploying and orchestrating agents with sessions, sandboxes, tools, memory, persistent state, and external integrations.

summaries.zh: 用于自托管和编排兼容 Claude API 的智能体，提供会话、沙箱、工具、记忆、持久化状态及外部服务集成。
summaries.en: A self-hosted runtime for orchestrating Claude-compatible agents with sessions, sandboxes, tools, memory, persistent state, and external service integrations.

capabilities: Runs and manages configurable AI agents and sessions
Executes agent workloads in sandboxes or local subprocess environments
Persists event logs, files, memory, and session state
Stores encrypted credentials and integration tokens
Connects agents to MCP, Slack, GitHub, and Linear integrations
